scenarios: InspectExtension shows publisher, source, UNSIGNED and every capability before anything loads
the unsigned extension loads quarantined: its hook never runs, its command is EXTENSION_QUARANTINED, its provider is not registered
trusting with a wrong digest is DIGEST_MISMATCH; with the inspected digest it becomes active
an unknown key is quarantined naming the key; a manifest changed after signing is INVALID, quarantined and EXTENSION_TAMPERED
a trusted publisher's extension is VERIFIED and active on load; a manifest changed after inspection is EXTENSION_CHANGED
audit: NOT-FOUND before: extensions loaded active with no publisher, source or signature and nothing shown before activation.
proof: Real Core: publisher, source, signature and capabilities are shown before activation, and anything not verified by a trusted publisher is quarantined until the person trusts its exact manifest.
negative_proof: A tampered manifest can never be trusted; a quarantined extension's hooks, tools, commands and providers stay inert.
limitations: The surface is the protocol (any client); no desktop extensions panel; no key revocation list.
